chunks: Muʿāwiyah ibn Wahb asked Abā ʿAbdِ اللَّهِ عليه السلام about the tathwīb that occurs between the adhan and the iqamah.
So he said: “We do not recognize it.”

key_terms.أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Title of Imam Jaʿfar al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام
key_terms.التَّثْوِيبِ: A supplementary call or announcement made between the adhan and the iqamah
key_terms.الْإِقَامَةِ: The call marking the commencement of salat (prayer)
key_terms.مَا نَعْرِفُهُ: We do not recognize it; a formula indicating non-acceptance of the practice
key_terms.مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ وَهْبٍ: A narrator who asked the Imam عليه السلام this legal question

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام say about tathwīb between the adhan and the iqamah?
ai.summary: This hadith records Muʿāwiyah ibn Wahb asking Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام about tathwīb between the adhan and the iqamah. The Imam عليه السلام replies that this practice is not recognized, indicating its disapproval in this ritual context.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.895 - Muawiya ibn Wahb asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) about the practice of "tathwib" (additional announcements or calls made between the adhan and the iqamah).
Imam (as) replied: "We do not recognize it”.
